headline: Profitability rebounds from year-ago loss, margins expand
summary_short: Columbia Sportswear posted Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS of $0.52 versus a $0.19 per-share loss a year ago, as revenue rose 1.5% y/y to $614.4M and gross margin expanded to roughly 58.3% from 49.1%.
summary_long: Diluted EPS was $0.52, versus a $0.19 loss a year ago and down from $0.65 in Q1 FY2026. Revenue was $614.4M, up 1.5% y/y but down 21.1% q/q on normal seasonality. Gross margin expanded to about 58.3% from 49.1% y/y and 50.7% q/q. Operating income and net income both swung from year-ago losses to $30.9M and $26.6M, though both eased from Q1 FY2026 levels. Cash rose to $532.3M, up 66.7% q/q and 24.4% y/y. Shareholders' equity was $1,601.6M, down 3.2% y/y.
